Metadata.title: Fi Sikkati — Find people already going your way
Metadata.description: Community ride-sharing for El Obour City and nearby areas. Drivers publish the trips they already plan to make; passengers find one going their way and request a seat.

Landing.headline: Find people already going your way.
Landing.subheadline: Not a taxi. Neighbours share seats on trips they are already making — searchable by route and time instead of buried in a WhatsApp group.

publish.title: A driver publishes a trip
publish.body: Origin, destination, departure time, free seats.

discover.title: Passengers find it
discover.body: Search by where you are, where you're going and when. Only compatible routes show up.

join.title: Request, accept, ride
join.body: Ask for a seat, the driver accepts, you talk inside the trip, then rate each other.

Landing.trustTitle: Built for a community, not a marketplace
Landing.trustBody: Verified drivers, verified riders, approximate pickup locations, in-app chat and a real reporting system — the structure the group chat never had.
Landing.statusNote: Fi Sikkati is under active development. Accounts and trips open with the first release.
